limitations: This is a read-only consistency audit, not new model inference, compiler execution, native execution or hardware attestation.

Model and llama.cpp shared-library identities were compared across retained before/after records; the multi-gigabyte model files and every runtime shared library were not independently rehashed by this audit.
Source identity is mapped to exact Git commits and compiler Python bytes; equal compiler hashes do not make the two experiment protocols identical.
The native JSON experiment was designed after observing the strict-format failure. It is separately frozen before its own execution and must not erase, retry or rescore the original strict results.
The models are 0.5B and 1.5B quantizations from one Qwen family, with eight fixed single-site tasks and one greedy attempt per cell. No population-level or multi-family benefit is established.
Unstarted strict 1.5B task cells are explicit missing work, not scored zero-cost successes or observed coding failures. Actual preflight costs are included in the aggregate generation cost.

Token totals cover all retained actual completion requests including preflights. Recorded completion timings exclude model setup/loading, prompt-template/tokenization work, provision/training and human labor; native evaluation time is separate.

HIA full/query comparison changes both representation and context. HIA fixtures have two functions in one module; Rust fixtures use two files. This does not isolate language effects or establish HIA cross-module maintenance.
All primary and secondary criteria remain false in both protocols; neither run establishes general productivity or total development-cost improvement.

native_json_grammar.text:
array ::= "[" space ( value ("," space value)* )? space "]"
boolean ::= ("true" | "false")
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
decimal-part ::= [0-9]{1,16}
integral-part ::= [0] | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15}
null ::= "null"
number ::= ("-"? integral-part) ("." decimal-part)? ([eE] [-+]? integral-part)?
object ::= "{" space ( string ":" space value ("," space string ":" space value)* )? space "}"
root ::= object
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
string ::= "\"" char* "\""
value ::= object | array | string | number | boolean | null
